# InfinityFree Account Manager Agent & GitHub Auto-Sync Build an autonomous agent to manage InfinityFree hosting accounts, domains, and subdomains, deploy and showcase hosted APK projects, and establish continuous two-way synchronization of conversations, artifacts, and codebase changes to GitHub. ## User Review Required > [!IMPORTANT] > - **GitHub Repository Name**: We propose creating and linking `thakoralpesh3/infinityfree` (or `thakoralpesh3/infinityfree-manager`). Please let us know if you prefer a different repository name. > - **InfinityFree Account Credentials**: InfinityFree uses FTP (`ftpupload.net`) and Client Area credentials. We will create a `.env.example` and a secure local `.env` file where you can provide your InfinityFree account details (`IF_FTP_USER`, `IF_FTP_PASS`, `IF_FTP_HOST`). > - **Local APK Discovery**: The agent will automatically scan your existing APK build outputs (`/home/alpesh/Web2APK_Output` and `/home/alpesh/APK_TV_Converter_Output`) to map your mobile and Android TV APKs to InfinityFree domains. ## Proposed Architecture & Workflow ```mermaid graph TD User([User Request / Antigravity]) --> Agent[InfinityFree Agent CLI & Engine] Agent --> Catalog[Domains & Projects Catalog
config/domains.json] Agent --> Scanner[APK Scanner
Web2APK & TV Converter Outputs] Agent --> FTP[InfinityFree FTP Manager
ftpupload.net / htdocs] Agent --> Portal[Landing Page Generator
HTML5 + QR Code + Download Portal] Agent --> Health[Domain Health & SSL Checker] Agent --> DocsGen[GitHub Catalog Generator
DOMAINS.md & README.md] subgraph Sync Engine Daemon[Sync Daemon
sync/sync_daemon.py] --> Conv[Transcripts -> CONVERSATION.md] Daemon --> Art[Artifacts Sync] Daemon --> Git[Git Commit & Push -> GitHub] end ``` --- ## Proposed Changes ### 1. Repository & GitHub Initialization #### [NEW] [.gitignore](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/.gitignore) - Ignore sensitive files (`.env`, credentials, local caches, temporary build files). - Keep config templates and manifests tracked. #### [NEW] [README.md](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/README.md) - Main project documentation detailing the InfinityFree Manager Agent, CLI commands, domain list showcase, and architecture. #### [NEW] [DOMAINS.md](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/DOMAINS.md) - Structured live catalog of all InfinityFree domains and subdomains, their current HTTP health status, associated GitHub repositories, and hosted APK assets with direct download links. --- ### 2. Live Conversation & Code Auto-Sync Engine #### [NEW] [sync/sync_daemon.py](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/sync/sync_daemon.py) - Continuously monitors conversation `ce8d996e-7ead-45d9-aaae-b8c03cf0515a`. - Converts raw `transcript.jsonl` into a formatted, readable `conversation/CONVERSATION.md` including user inputs, agent replies, thinking blocks, and tool action summaries. - Copies full transcripts and artifacts (`implementation_plan.md`, `walkthrough.md`) into `artifacts/`. - Executes automated `git add`, `git commit`, and `git push` to GitHub with customizable interval (`--interval`) or one-shot (`--once`). #### [NEW] [sync_to_github.sh](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/sync_to_github.sh) - Executable helper script to trigger an immediate sync and push to GitHub. #### [NEW] [sync/infinityfree-sync.service](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/sync/infinityfree-sync.service) - Systemd user service unit for persistent, background auto-syncing. --- ### 3. InfinityFree Manager Agent Engine #### [NEW] [agent/config.py](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/agent/config.py) - Loads environment variables, validates FTP and account configurations, and manages multi-account configurations. #### [NEW] [agent/ftp_client.py](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/agent/ftp_client.py) - High-resilience FTP/FTPS client tailored for InfinityFree (`ftpupload.net:21`). - Features: connection test, recursive directory creation (`htdocs/apk/...`), file upload with progress, and `.htaccess` MIME-type setup for APK delivery. #### [NEW] [agent/apk_scanner.py](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/agent/apk_scanner.py) - Discovers APKs from local directories (`/home/alpesh/Web2APK_Output`, `/home/alpesh/APK_TV_Converter_Output`) and GitHub releases. - Parses app name, version, target architecture (mobile, Android TV, universal), size, and sha256 checksums. #### [NEW] [agent/portal_builder.py](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/agent/portal_builder.py) - Automatically produces a high-converting, mobile-friendly landing page (`index.html`) for any hosted domain or subdomain. - Features: responsive dark-mode styling, dynamic QR code for instant phone scanning, app badges, device compatibility chips, and one-click download buttons. #### [NEW] [agent/catalog.py](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/agent/catalog.py) - Manages `config/domains.json` mapping all InfinityFree domains/subdomains to their active work, projects, and hosted APKs. - Allows adding, updating, and removing domains. #### [NEW] [agent/health_checker.py](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/agent/health_checker.py) - Performs HTTP/HTTPS health checks, status code detection, DNS resolution, and verifies APK download URLs. #### [NEW] [agent/markdown_generator.py](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/agent/markdown_generator.py) - Formats domain and APK data into GitHub markdown (`DOMAINS.md`) with badges and interactive tables. #### [NEW] [agent/cli.py](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/agent/cli.py) - Command-line interface with subcommands: - `list-domains`: Display table of all domains, status, and hosted APKs. - `add-domain`: Register a new InfinityFree domain/subdomain and link to project. - `deploy`: Package APK + landing portal and upload to InfinityFree domain via FTP. - `scan-apks`: Auto-discover local APKs and match them to domains. - `health-check`: Test live availability of all domains. - `sync-github`: Update `DOMAINS.md` and push to GitHub. #### [NEW] [infinityfree_agent.sh](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/infinityfree_agent.sh) - Master executable CLI runner. #### [NEW] [requirements.txt](file:///home/alpesh/infinityfree/requirements.txt) - Lightweight dependencies (`requests`, `python-dotenv`, `urllib3`, etc.). --- ## Verification Plan ### Automated Tests 1. **GitHub CLI & Remote Verification**: - Run `python3 -m agent.cli --help` - Run `python3 -m agent.cli scan-apks` to verify APK discovery from output folders. - Run `python3 -m agent.cli list-domains` to verify domain catalog rendering. - Run `python3 -m agent.cli sync-github` to verify `DOMAINS.md` generation. 4. **FTP & Deployment Dry-Run**: - Test portal builder generation: verify generated HTML has valid QR code and download links. ### Manual Verification - Review generated `DOMAINS.md` and `README.md` on GitHub at `https://github.com/thakoralpesh3/infinityfree`.

import os
import re
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict
from agent.config import Config

class APKScanner:
    def __init__(self, dirs: List[Path] = None):
        self.dirs = dirs or [Config.WEB2APK_OUTPUT_DIR, Config.APK_TV_OUTPUT_DIR]

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_apk_filename(filename: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
        """Parses app name, version, and target device from common naming conventions."""
        base = filename[:-4] if filename.endswith(".apk") else filename

        # Target detection
        target = "Universal"
        if "android-tv" in base.lower() or "converted-tv" in base.lower():
            target = "Android TV"
        elif "smartphone" in base.lower() or "mobile" in base.lower():
            target = "Smartphone"
        elif "universal" in base.lower():
            target = "Universal"

        # Version regex e.g. -v1.0.0 or _7.0.9
        version_match = re.search(r"[-_]v?(\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?)", base)
        version = version_match.group(1) if version_match else "1.0.0"

        # Extract app name by removing target and version tags
        cleaned = re.sub(r"[-_]v?\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?.*", "", base)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"[-_](universal|android-tv|smartphone|converted-tv|converted-mobile)", "", cleaned, flags=re.I)
        app_name = cleaned.replace("_", " ").replace("-", " ").strip()
        if not app_name:
            app_name = base

        return {
            "app_name": app_name.title(),
            "version": version,
            "device_target": target
        }

    def scan_all_apks(self) -> List[Dict]:
        results = []
        for d in self.dirs:
            if not d.exists() or not d.is_dir():
                continue

            for file_path in d.glob("*.apk"):
                size_bytes = file_path.stat().st_size
                if size_bytes == 0:
                    continue  # Ignore empty files

                size_kb = round(size_bytes / 1024, 1)
                size_mb = round(size_bytes / (1024 * 1024), 2)
                parsed = self._parse_apk_filename(file_path.name)

                # Compute quick sha256
                hasher = hashlib.sha256()
                with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
                    for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
                        hasher.update(chunk)
                checksum = hasher.hexdigest()

                # Check for companion metadata files
                base_stem = file_path.stem
                listing_md = file_path.parent / f"{base_stem}-AI-Store-Listing.md"
                audit_json = file_path.parent / f"{base_stem}-AI-TV-Audit.json"

                results.append({
                    "filename": file_path.name,
                    "filepath": str(file_path),
                    "directory": str(d),
                    "size_bytes": size_bytes,
                    "size_kb": size_kb,
                    "size_mb": size_mb,
                    "sha256": checksum,
                    "app_name": parsed["app_name"],
                    "version": parsed["version"],
                    "device_target": parsed["device_target"],
                    "has_store_listing": listing_md.exists(),
                    "has_audit": audit_json.exists()
                })

        return sorted(results, key=lambda x: x["app_name"])

import os
import ftplib
import ssl
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Tuple, List, Optional
from agent.config import Config

class InfinityFreeFTP:
    def __init__(self, host: str = None, user: str = None, password: str = None, port: int = 21):
        self.host = host or Config.FTP_HOST
        self.user = user or Config.FTP_USER
        self.password = password or Config.FTP_PASS
        self.port = port or Config.FTP_PORT

    def is_configured(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.host and self.user and self.password)

    def _connect(self) -> ftplib.FTP:
        if not self.is_configured():
            raise ValueError(
                "InfinityFree FTP credentials are not configured. "
                "Please configure IF_FTP_USER and IF_FTP_PASS in your .env file."
            )

        try:
            # Try FTPS (TLS) first
            ftps = ftplib.FTP_TLS(timeout=30)
            ftps.connect(self.host, self.port)
            ftps.login(self.user, self.password)
            ftps.prot_p()  # Secure data connection
            return ftps
        except Exception:
            # Fallback to plain FTP
            ftp = ftplib.FTP(timeout=30)
            ftp.connect(self.host, self.port)
            ftp.login(self.user, self.password)
            return ftp

    def test_connection(self) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        if not self.is_configured():
            return False, "FTP credentials missing (IF_FTP_USER / IF_FTP_PASS not set in .env)"
        try:
            ftp = self._connect()
            welcome = ftp.getwelcome()
            ftp.quit()
            return True, f"Successfully connected to {self.host} ({welcome.strip()})"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Connection failed: {str(e)}"

    def list_dir(self, remote_dir: str = "/") -> List[str]:
        ftp = self._connect()
        try:
            ftp.cwd(remote_dir)
            files = ftp.nlst()
            return files
        finally:
            ftp.quit()

    def ensure_dir(self, remote_path: str) -> None:
        """Recursively ensures remote directories exist."""
        ftp = self._connect()
        try:
            parts = [p for p in remote_path.strip("/").split("/") if p]
            current = ""
            for part in parts:
                current += f"/{part}"
                try:
                    ftp.cwd(current)
                except ftplib.error_perm:
                    try:
                        ftp.mkd(current)
                        ftp.cwd(current)
                    except Exception as e:
                        pass
        finally:
            ftp.quit()

    def upload_file(self, local_path: Path, remote_dest_path: str) -> bool:
        """Uploads a local file to remote_dest_path (full remote path including filename)."""
        local_path = Path(local_path)
        if not local_path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Local file not found: {local_path}")

        parent_dir = str(Path(remote_dest_path).parent).replace("\\", "/")
        self.ensure_dir(parent_dir)

        ftp = self._connect()
        try:
            with open(local_path, "rb") as f:
                ftp.storbinary(f"STOR {remote_dest_path}", f, blocksize=65536)
            return True
        finally:
            ftp.quit()

    def setup_apk_htaccess(self, target_htdocs: str = "htdocs") -> bool:
        """Uploads or updates .htaccess in target htdocs to support APK downloads."""
        htaccess_content = (
            "# InfinityFree APK & Portal Configuration\n"
            "AddType application/vnd.android.package-archive .apk\n"
            "AddType application/octet-stream .ipa\n"
            "Options -Indexes\n"
            "<FilesMatch \"\\.(apk|ipa)$\">\n"
            "    Header set Content-Disposition \"attachment\"\n"
            "</FilesMatch>\n"
        )
        temp_file = Config.BASE_DIR / "staging" / ".htaccess"
        temp_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(temp_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(htaccess_content)

        remote_path = f"/{target_htdocs.strip('/')}/.htaccess"
        return self.upload_file(temp_file, remote_path)

import sys
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tabulate import tabulate
from agent.config import Config
from agent.catalog import DomainCatalog
from agent.apk_scanner import APKScanner
from agent.ftp_client import InfinityFreeFTP
from agent.portal_builder import PortalBuilder
from agent.health_checker import DomainHealthChecker
from agent.markdown_generator import MarkdownGenerator

def cmd_status(args):
    print("\n--- InfinityFree Manager Agent Status ---")
    summary = Config.get_summary()
    print(f"GitHub Repository: {summary['github_target']}")
    print(f"FTP Host:          {summary['ftp_host']}:{summary['ftp_port']}")
    print(f"FTP Configured:    {'✓ Yes' if summary['ftp_user_configured'] else '✗ No (Set IF_FTP_USER and IF_FTP_PASS in .env)'}")
    print(f"Web2APK Output:    {'✓ Found' if summary['web2apk_dir_exists'] else '✗ Missing'} ({Config.WEB2APK_OUTPUT_DIR})")
    print(f"APK TV Output:     {'✓ Found' if summary['apk_tv_dir_exists'] else '✗ Missing'} ({Config.APK_TV_OUTPUT_DIR})")
    
    catalog = DomainCatalog()
    domains = catalog.list_all()
    total_apks = sum(len(d.get("hosted_apks", [])) for d in domains)
    print(f"Active Domains:    {len(domains)}")
    print(f"Total Hosted APKs: {total_apks}\n")

def cmd_list_domains(args):
    catalog = DomainCatalog()
    domains = catalog.list_all()
    if not domains:
        print("No domains configured in catalog yet. Use 'add-domain' to register one.")
        return

    table_data = []
    for d in domains:
        apks_count = len(d.get("hosted_apks", []))
        table_data.append([
            d.get("domain"),
            d.get("status", "configured"),
            d.get("project", "General"),
            d.get("github_repo", ""),
            apks_count,
            d.get("target_dir", "htdocs")
        ])

    headers = ["Domain / Subdomain", "Status", "Project / Work", "GitHub Repo", "APKs", "FTP Target"]
    print("\n" + tabulate(table_data, headers=headers, tablefmt="fancy_grid") + "\n")

def cmd_add_domain(args):
    catalog = DomainCatalog()
    domain_data = {
        "domain": args.domain,
        "project": args.project or "Android Web Application",
        "github_repo": args.repo or f"{Config.GITHUB_USER}/infinityfree",
        "description": args.description or f"Official landing portal and APK distribution for {args.domain}",
        "target_dir": args.target_dir or "htdocs"
    }
    try:
        res = catalog.add(domain_data)
        print(f"✓ Domain '{res['domain']}' successfully added to catalog.")
        # Regenerate DOMAINS.md
        MarkdownGenerator.write_domains_md(catalog.list_all())
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error adding domain: {e}")

def cmd_remove_domain(args):
    catalog = DomainCatalog()
    if catalog.remove(args.domain):
        print(f"✓ Domain '{args.domain}' removed from catalog.")
        MarkdownGenerator.write_domains_md(catalog.list_all())
    else:
        print(f"Domain '{args.domain}' not found.")

def cmd_scan_apks(args):
    scanner = APKScanner()
    apks = scanner.scan_all_apks()
    print(f"\n--- Discovered {len(apks)} Local APK Builds ---")
    table_data = []
    for a in apks:
        table_data.append([
            a["app_name"],
            a["version"],
            a["device_target"],
            f"{a['size_kb']} KB",
            a["filename"]
        ])
    headers = ["App Name", "Version", "Target", "Size", "Filename"]
    print(tabulate(table_data, headers=headers, tablefmt="simple") + "\n")

    if args.link:
        # Match APKs to catalog domains based on keyword
        catalog = DomainCatalog()
        domains = catalog.list_all()
        linked_count = 0
        for apk in apks:
            app_lower = apk["app_name"].lower().replace(" ", "")
            for d in domains:
                d_lower = d["domain"].lower()
                proj_lower = d.get("project", "").lower().replace(" ", "")
                if app_lower in d_lower or app_lower in proj_lower:
                    catalog.link_apk(d["domain"], {
                        "filename": apk["filename"],
                        "app_name": apk["app_name"],
                        "version": apk["version"],
                        "device_target": apk["device_target"],
                        "size_kb": apk["size_kb"],
                        "download_path": f"apk/{apk['filename']}"
                    })
                    linked_count += 1
                    print(f"Linked '{apk['filename']}' to domain '{d['domain']}'")
        print(f"Finished auto-linking: {linked_count} association(s) updated.")
        MarkdownGenerator.write_domains_md(catalog.list_all())

def cmd_build_portal(args):
    catalog = DomainCatalog()
    domain_info = catalog.get(args.domain)
    if not domain_info:
        print(f"Domain '{args.domain}' not found in catalog.")
        return

    output_dir = Config.BASE_DIR / "staging" / args.domain
    index_file = PortalBuilder.generate_portal_files(domain_info, output_dir)
    print(f"✓ Portal generated at: {index_file}")

def cmd_health_check(args):
    catalog = DomainCatalog()
    domains = catalog.list_all()
    print(f"\nChecking live connectivity for {len(domains)} domain(s)...")
    results = DomainHealthChecker.check_all(domains)

    table_data = []
    health_map = {}
    for r in results:
        health_map[r["domain"]] = r
        table_data.append([
            r["domain"],
            "✓ Yes" if r["dns_resolved"] else "✗ No",
            r["http_status"],
            r["https_status"],
            f"{r['response_time_ms']} ms" if r['response_time_ms'] else "N/A",
            r["status_label"]
        ])
    headers = ["Domain", "DNS", "HTTP", "HTTPS", "Response Time", "Status"]
    print("\n" + tabulate(table_data, headers=headers, tablefmt="fancy_grid") + "\n")

    if args.sync:
        MarkdownGenerator.write_domains_md(domains, health_map)
        print("✓ Updated DOMAINS.md with live health check data.")

def cmd_sync_github(args):
    catalog = DomainCatalog()
    domains = catalog.list_all()
    out_file = MarkdownGenerator.write_domains_md(domains)
    print(f"✓ Generated and updated {out_file}")

def cmd_deploy(args):
    catalog = DomainCatalog()
    domain_info = catalog.get(args.domain)
    if not domain_info:
        print(f"Domain '{args.domain}' not found in catalog.")
        return

    ftp = InfinityFreeFTP()
    if not ftp.is_configured():
        print("FTP is not configured. Please set IF_FTP_USER and IF_FTP_PASS in .env")
        return

    print(f"Connecting to InfinityFree FTP ({ftp.host})...")
    ok, msg = ftp.test_connection()
    if not ok:
        print(f"FTP connection failed: {msg}")
        return
    print(f"✓ {msg}")

    target_htdocs = domain_info.get("target_dir", "htdocs")
    print(f"Setting up .htaccess in /{target_htdocs}...")
    ftp.setup_apk_htaccess(target_htdocs)

    print("Building responsive HTML portal...")
    staging_dir = Config.BASE_DIR / "staging" / args.domain
    index_html = PortalBuilder.generate_portal_files(domain_info, staging_dir)

    print(f"Uploading index.html to /{target_htdocs}/index.html...")
    ftp.upload_file(index_html, f"/{target_htdocs}/index.html")
    print("✓ Landing portal uploaded.")

    # Upload hosted APKs if requested
    if args.upload_apks:
        scanner = APKScanner()
        all_apks = {a["filename"]: a for a in scanner.scan_all_apks()}
        for apk in domain_info.get("hosted_apks", []):
            fn = apk.get("filename")
            if fn in all_apks:
                local_path = Path(all_apks[fn]["filepath"])
                remote_apk_path = f"/{target_htdocs}/apk/{fn}"
                print(f"Uploading APK {fn} ({all_apks[fn]['size_kb']} KB) -> {remote_apk_path}...")
                ftp.upload_file(local_path, remote_apk_path)
                print(f"✓ Uploaded {fn}")
            else:
                print(f"⚠️ Local APK file not found for {fn}, skipping binary upload.")

    print(f"\n🎉 Deployment complete! Visit: http://{args.domain}")

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="InfinityFree Account & Domain Manager Agent")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", help="Available subcommands")

    # status
    subparsers.add_parser("status", help="Show configuration & catalog status")

    # list-domains
    subparsers.add_parser("list-domains", help="List all registered domains and hosted APKs")

    # add-domain
    p_add = subparsers.add_parser("add-domain", help="Register a new domain/subdomain")
    p_add.add_argument("domain", help="Domain or subdomain name (e.g. app.epizy.com)")
    p_add.add_argument("--project", help="Project / application name")
    p_add.add_argument("--repo", help="Associated GitHub repo")
    p_add.add_argument("--description", help="Short description")
    p_add.add_argument("--target-dir", default="htdocs", help="InfinityFree htdocs target directory")

    # remove-domain
    p_rem = subparsers.add_parser("remove-domain", help="Remove a domain from catalog")
    p_rem.add_argument("domain", help="Domain name or ID")

    # scan-apks
    p_scan = subparsers.add_parser("scan-apks", help="Scan local directories for APK builds")
    p_scan.add_argument("--link", action="store_true", help="Auto-link found APKs to domains")

    # build-portal
    p_build = subparsers.add_parser("build-portal", help="Generate HTML portal locally")
    p_build.add_argument("domain", help="Domain to build portal for")

    # health-check
    p_health = subparsers.add_parser("health-check", help="Check DNS & HTTP status of domains")
    p_health.add_argument("--sync", action="store_true", help="Update DOMAINS.md with results")

    # sync-github
    subparsers.add_parser("sync-github", help="Generate DOMAINS.md for GitHub")

    # deploy
    p_dep = subparsers.add_parser("deploy", help="Deploy portal and APKs to InfinityFree via FTP")
    p_dep.add_argument("domain", help="Domain to deploy to")
    p_dep.add_argument("--upload-apks", action="store_true", help="Upload APK binary files to remote host")

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.command:
        parser.print_help()
        sys.exit(0)

    dispatch = {
        "status": cmd_status,
        "list-domains": cmd_list_domains,
        "add-domain": cmd_add_domain,
        "remove-domain": cmd_remove_domain,
        "scan-apks": cmd_scan_apks,
        "build-portal": cmd_build_portal,
        "health-check": cmd_health_check,
        "sync-github": cmd_sync_github,
        "deploy": cmd_deploy
    }

    func = dispatch.get(args.command)
    if func:
        func(args)
    else:
        parser.print_help()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Antigravity Conversation & InfinityFree Manager GitHub Auto-Sync Daemon
Tracks conversation transcripts, artifacts, domain catalogs, and codebase changes,
then automatically formats, commits, and pushes them to GitHub.
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import argparse
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

CONVERSATION_ID = "ce8d996e-7ead-45d9-aaae-b8c03cf0515a"
BRAIN_DIR = Path(f"/home/alpesh/.gemini/antigravity/brain/{CONVERSATION_ID}")

def parse_transcript_to_markdown(jsonl_path: Path) -> str:
    """Parses raw JSONL transcript into a structured, readable Markdown log."""
    if not jsonl_path.exists():
        return "# Conversation Log\n\n*No transcript available yet.*"

    md_lines = [
        "# 🤖 Antigravity Conversation Session Log",
        f"**Conversation ID**: `{CONVERSATION_ID}`  ",
        f"**Last Synced**: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}  ",
        "",
        "---",
        ""
    ]

    try:
        with open(jsonl_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                if not line.strip():
                    continue
                try:
                    entry = json.loads(line)
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    continue

                step_type = entry.get("type", "")
                created_at = entry.get("created_at", "")
                content = entry.get("content", "")
                thinking = entry.get("thinking", "")
                tool_calls = entry.get("tool_calls", [])

                if step_type == "USER_INPUT":
                    md_lines.append(f"### 👤 User Request ({created_at})\n")
                    md_lines.append(f"{content.strip()}\n")
                    md_lines.append("\n---\n")

                elif step_type == "PLANNER_RESPONSE":
                    md_lines.append(f"### 🤖 Antigravity Agent Response ({created_at})\n")
                    if thinking:
                        md_lines.append(f"<details><summary>🧠 Agent Internal Thought Process</summary>\n\n```text\n{thinking.strip()}\n```\n</details>\n")
                    if tool_calls:
                        md_lines.append("**Executed Tools:**")
                        for tc in tool_calls:
                            func = tc.get("function", {})
                            name = func.get("name", "tool")
                            args = func.get("arguments", {})
                            summary = args.get("toolSummary", name) if isinstance(args, dict) else name
                            md_lines.append(f"- 🔧 `{name}`: {summary}")
                        md_lines.append("")
                    if content and content.strip():
                        md_lines.append(f"{content.strip()}\n")
                    md_lines.append("\n---\n")

                elif step_type == "TOOL_OUTPUT":
                    output = entry.get("output", "")
                    if output:
                        snippet = output[:300] + ("..." if len(output) > 300 else "")
                        md_lines.append(f"<details><summary>📄 Tool Output Preview</summary>\n\n```text\n{snippet}\n```\n</details>\n")
    except Exception as e:
        md_lines.append(f"\n*Error formatting transcript: {e}*\n")

    return "\n".join(md_lines)


def update_catalog_markdown():
    """Regenerates DOMAINS.md from current catalog."""
    try:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_DIR))
        from agent.catalog import DomainCatalog
        from agent.markdown_generator import MarkdownGenerator
        catalog = DomainCatalog(REPO_DIR / "config" / "domains.json")
        MarkdownGenerator.write_domains_md(catalog.list_all())
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Notice: Could not regenerate DOMAINS.md: {e}")


def sync_cycle() -> bool:
    """Executes a single synchronization cycle. Returns True if changes were pushed."""
    CONVERSATION_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ARTIFACTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 1. Sync Transcripts
    logs_dir = BRAIN_DIR / ".system_generated" / "logs"
    transcript_src = logs_dir / "transcript.jsonl"
    transcript_full_src = logs_dir / "transcript_full.jsonl"

    if transcript_src.exists():
        shutil.copy2(transcript_src, CONVERSATION_DIR / "transcript.jsonl")
        formatted_md = parse_transcript_to_markdown(transcript_src)
        with open(CONVERSATION_DIR / "CONVERSATION.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(formatted_md)

    if transcript_full_src.exists():
        shutil.copy2(transcript_full_src, CONVERSATION_DIR / "transcript_full.jsonl")

    # 2. Sync Artifacts (implementation_plan.md, walkthrough.md, etc.)
    if BRAIN_DIR.exists():
        for item in BRAIN_DIR.glob("*.md"):
            shutil.copy2(item, ARTIFACTS_DIR / item.name)

    # 3. Update DOMAINS.md
    update_catalog_markdown()

    # 4. Check Git Status
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=REPO_DIR, capture_output=True)
    status = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=REPO_DIR, capture_output=True, text=True
    )

    if not status.stdout.strip():
        return False

    # 5. Commit and Push
    now_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

# 🚀 InfinityFree Autonomous Account & Hosting Agent

[![GitHub Auto-Sync](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Auto--Sync-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/thakoralpesh3/infinityfree)
[![Managed Domains](https://img.shields.io/badge/InfinityFree-6%20Domains-00ffcc.svg)](DOMAINS.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

An autonomous AI Agent designed to manage **InfinityFree** web hosting accounts, organize and automate custom domains & subdomains, package and deploy Android APK download portals with embedded QR codes, and maintain real-time bidirectional synchronization with GitHub and Google Antigravity conversations.

---

## 🌐 Live Hosted Domains & APK Work Catalog

---

## 🌟 Core Features

- ⚡ **Automated InfinityFree FTP Management**: Full connection lifecycle to `ftpupload.net:21`, recursive directory creation, upload progress tracking, and MIME-type configuration via automated `.htaccess`.
- 📱 **Zero-Config APK Landing Pages**: Auto-generates responsive, dark-mode download portals with inline base64 QR codes for instant smartphone & Android TV camera scanning.
- 🔍 **Intelligent Local APK Discovery**: Automatically indexes APK builds from `/home/alpesh/Web2APK_Output` and `/home/alpesh/APK_TV_Converter_Output` and correlates them with domains.
- 🩺 **Domain Health & DNS Watchdog**: Regularly pings domains for DNS resolution, HTTP/HTTPS response codes, and verified APK download URL reachability.
- 🔄 **Conversation & Code GitHub Auto-Sync**: Automatically formats live Antigravity transcripts (`transcript.jsonl` -> `conversation/CONVERSATION.md`), captures artifacts, and pushes commits to GitHub.

---

## 🛠️ Architecture Overview

```
infinityfree/
├── agent/                         # Core InfinityFree Agent Engine
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── config.py                  # Environment & credentials loader
│   ├── catalog.py                 # domains.json manager
│   ├── apk_scanner.py             # Local APK indexer & analyzer
│   ├── ftp_client.py              # ftpupload.net FTPS/FTP engine
│   ├── portal_builder.py          # HTML5 + QR code download portal generator
│   ├── health_checker.py          # HTTP, DNS & link validator
│   ├── markdown_generator.py      # DOMAINS.md generator
│   └── cli.py                     # CLI entrypoint
├── config/
│   └── domains.json               # Domain-to-project & APK mapping
├── sync/                          # Auto-Sync to GitHub
│   ├── sync_daemon.py             # Continuous watcher & pusher
│   └── infinityfree-sync.service  # Systemd user service
├── conversation/                  # Synced Antigravity conversation transcripts
├── artifacts/                     # Synced planning & walkthrough artifacts
├── infinityfree_agent.sh          # Quick CLI runner
├── sync_to_github.sh              # One-shot sync helper
├── DOMAINS.md                     # GitHub showcase matrix
└── requirements.txt
```

---

## 🚀 Quick Start & CLI Usage

### 1. Configure Credentials
Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in your InfinityFree hosting credentials (available in the InfinityFree Client Area):
```bash
cp .env.example .env
nano .env
```
Key variables:
- `IF_FTP_HOST=ftpupload.net`
- `IF_FTP_USER=epiz_xxxxxxxx`
- `IF_FTP_PASS=your_vpanel_password`

### 2. View Agent Status
```bash
./infinityfree_agent.sh status
```

### 3. List Registered Domains & Work
```bash
./infinityfree_agent.sh list-domains
```

### 4. Scan & Auto-Link Local APKs
```bash
./infinityfree_agent.sh scan-apks --link
```

### 5. Add a New Domain or Subdomain
```bash
./infinityfree_agent.sh add-domain myapp.epizy.com \
  --project "My New App" \
  --repo "thakoralpesh3/web-to-apk-autonomous-agent" \
  --description "Download portal for My New App"
```

### 6. Build Local Landing Portal
```bash
./infinityfree_agent.sh build-portal anime4all.epizy.com
```

### 7. Run Live Health Check
```bash
./infinityfree_agent.sh health-check --sync
```

### 8. Deploy to InfinityFree Host
Uploads `.htaccess`, generated landing page, and APK files directly to InfinityFree:
```bash
./infinityfree_agent.sh deploy anime4all.epizy.com --upload-apks
```

---

## 🔄 Automatic GitHub Sync

To perform an immediate one-shot synchronization of your codebase, artifacts, and conversation:
```bash
./sync_to_github.sh
```

To run the sync daemon in the background or enable systemd service:
```bash
python3 sync/sync_daemon.py --interval 30
```
Or install as a systemd user service:
```bash
mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user
cp sync/infinityfree-sync.service ~/.config/systemd/user/
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now infinityfree-sync.service
```
